tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sku 'dra mdze thod mar na bza' dang sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs rje btsun du zhabs tog bgyis pa'i yi ge tshigs bcad ma// na mo badz+ra dha ra kirti dh+wa dza ye/ gnas mchog dpal ldan sa skya'i rig 'dzin dbang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan dngos dang dbyer med pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sku 'dra mdze thod mar/ 1 /hor gos khyad par can las grub pa yi/ /na bza' yid 'phrog sku ber sbu gu can/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes mchod pa bla med dang / /gtsug lag khang gi phyogs kun ma lus par/ 2 /bris thang ngo mtshar lam 'bras brgyud pa dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa khyad par rje btsun dang / /sa paṇa khu dbon rnam thar zhing bkod gnyis/ /sngags 'chang yab sras rje btsun grol mchog gi 3 /sku skye bcu gcig byon pa'i bkod pa dang / /kye rdor bka' babs bzhi yi dkyil thang sogs/ /tshar du dngar bar bzhugs pa'i lha khang gi /sa rgyan mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed dang / 4 /gnam rgyan lha rdzas mchog la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /gos bzang khyad par can gyi bla bre sogs/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog zhabs tog phul phyin 'di/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ 5 /rang lo re gsum lon pa phag gi lo/ /gsar du bsgrubs pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi/ /bdag gzhan dge ba ji snyed bsags pa'i mthus/ /shes rgyud sgrib gnyis bag chags kun byang nas/ 6 /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa rgyas sogs bsam pa mthar phyin nas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob kun kyang 'bral med lhan cig par/ /'jigs rung bar do'i 'jigs skrag dang bral nas/ /mkha' spyod mngon dga' bde ba can sogs su/ /smon lam dbang gis thogs med legs 'dzoms nas/ /rang rgyud grol te rnam 'phrul du ma yis/ /spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /srid mtha'i bar du yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/

/'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'i mthu ldan shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sku 'dra mdze thod mar na bza' dang sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs rje btsun du zhabs tog bgyis pa'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
